edits.brand.name: AgentBNB
edits.hero.title: Operate Airbnb-style properties with an AI-Agent
edits.hero.definition: AgentBNB is a white-label hospitality operations stack for running Airbnb-like properties with an AI agent.
edits.hero.origin: Born from Balay Pansol, a real family-run short-stay property, and Gideon, the hospitality agent that operate its it digital stack.
edits.hero.operatorNote: SAVE HUNDREDS OF DOLLARS IN OPEX AND TIME. The Base Monthly Operating Cost of the running AgentBNB $50USD/MO
edits.features.agent.title: AI hospitality agent
edits.features.agent.body: Inquiry triage, guest messaging, owner recommendations, and controlled booking progression.
edits.features.sor.title: Property SoR
edits.features.sor.body: Markdown operating truth for amenities, rules, rates, scripts, limitations, and agent context.
edits.features.site.title: White-label site
edits.features.site.body: Direct booking page, owner dashboard, spreadsheet records, Resend email, and guest review loop.
edits.features.harnesses.title: Ops harnesses
edits.features.harnesses.body: Growing harness tools for the agent to continuously optimize and keep your property competitive.
edits.paths.stack-tour.label: Open source
edits.paths.stack-tour.title: Run the Stack, Contribute, Donate.
edits.paths.stack-tour.body: AgentBNB runs an open source component shared from real implementation. Savvy users can run the stack themselves, developers are open to contribute, and donating to allow continuous development goes a long way.
edits.paths.advisory.label: Implementation
edits.paths.advisory.title: Inquire for Assisted Setup & Advisory
edits.paths.advisory.body: Accepting white-glove and curated setup for serious operators looking to apply AgentBNB to their properties. Email at mail@joejosue.com
edits.paths.open-implementation.title: Inspect the open implementation
edits.paths.open-implementation.body: The implementation starter is open source for technical operators and builders who want to study, fork, or support the project.
